source.provider: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation / NYC OpenData
source.licenseNote: Public NYC Open Data dataset; retain source attribution and consult NYC Open Data terms for downstream reuse.

acquisition.nominalPulseDensity: at least 8 pulses/m2 for citywide topographic data

coordinateReference.horizontal: EPSG:2263 NAD83 / New York Long Island (US survey feet)

sampleStrategy: Seeded random sample of measured LAS returns; same nested return sample across 3 LOD tiers; RGB sampled from the registered NYS orthophoto.

anchor.verticalOriginMethod: median of measured LAS class-2 ground returns within 200 ft of tile center

lods.name: CITY_TILE
lods.binaryLayout: int16le xyz positions quantized at 0.02 metres followed by uint8 RGB from NYS orthophoto

lods.name: BLOCKS
lods.binaryLayout: int16le xyz positions quantized at 0.02 metres followed by uint8 RGB from NYS orthophoto

lods.name: DETAIL
lods.binaryLayout: int16le xyz positions quantized at 0.02 metres followed by uint8 RGB from NYS orthophoto

imagery.provider: New York State ITS Geospatial Services
imagery.description: Latest NYS orthoimagery, combined 2022–2025 natural-color imagery; image export centered on each measured LiDAR tile.
imagery.format: WebP natural-color orthophoto texture derived from the NYS JPEG export
imagery.method: Real orthophoto pixels draped onto measured LiDAR roof and ground surface; vertical facade planes remain separately LiDAR-derived.

materialization.method: Measured NYC OpenData LiDAR returns materialized as roof-supported 2m triangles plus a measured-ground DTM and registered NYS orthophoto drape
materialization.surfaceMesh: Nadir photo mesh uses source-derived elevated roof-mask cells plus measured class-2 ground; non-roof unclassified returns are not elevated mesh vertices, and corner smoothing is edge-preserving
materialization.verticalWalls: Neutral shaded vertical quads derived from roof-mask boundaries against the measured-ground DTM; no nadir imagery is stretched onto facades
materialization.coordinateGrid: Cell footprints snapped to EPSG:2263 2m bins and independently anchored per LiDAR tile

surfaceMesh.binaryLayout: int16le xyz positions at 0.02m, uint16le normalized UV pairs, uint32le chunk-local triangle indices
surfaceMesh.wallBinaryLayout: int16le xyz positions at 0.02m, uint8 RGB wall-shading colors, uint32le triangle indices
surfaceMesh.wallMaterial: neutral shaded vertical faces derived from measured LiDAR roof boundaries
surfaceMesh.wallMethod: vertical quads between sustained elevated LiDAR roof-mask regions and the measured-ground DTM
surfaceMesh.surfaceClassPolicy: real orthophoto draped only over source-derived elevated roof-mask cells and measured class-2 ground; non-roof unclassified returns do not become elevated photo-mesh vertices
surfaceMesh.cornerSmoothing: corner-specific local means restricted to the same roof/ground class and neighboring heights within 1.5 metres; larger breaks stay sharp
surfaceMesh.triangulationMethod: two triangles per measured 2m cell with independent cell-local vertices so roof-ground and roof-height breaks do not stretch across facades

chunks.binaryLayout: int16le xyz positions, uint16le normalized UV pairs, uint32le local triangle indices
